symptom: PC gets IP but cannot reach server in VLAN 30; gateway ping works
topology_note: VLAN30 SVI up, trunk to core
show_output: show ip route: no entry for 10.0.30.0; show access-lists: ACL 101 applied inbound
expected_fault: Missing route to VLAN 30 subnet

symptom: Two PCs on same VLAN report intermittent connectivity and MAC flapping
show_output: show ip interface brief: two hosts both configured 192.168.10.10
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address

symptom: New host cannot get an IP address via DHCP
show_output: show ip dhcp binding: pool empty; show run | section dhcp: pool exhausted
expected_fault: DHCP pool exhausted

symptom: Host can reach gateway but nothing beyond it
show_output: show interfaces: Gi0/1 mask 255.255.255.0 on host vs 255.255.255.128 on gateway
expected_fault: Subnet mask mismatch between host and gateway

symptom: PC in VLAN50 cannot resolve external hostnames but IP connectivity works
show_output: show run | include dns; nslookup fails, ping to 8.8.8.8 succeeds
expected_fault: DNS server unreachable or misconfigured

symptom: Trunk link between switches drops VLAN 60 traffic only
show_output: show interfaces trunk: VLAN 60 not in allowed list
expected_fault: VLAN not permitted on trunk allowed list

symptom: Router will not route between VLAN 70 and VLAN 80
show_output: show ip interface brief: Gi0/0.80 administratively down
expected_fault: Sub-interface administratively down

symptom: Internal hosts cannot reach the internet despite valid default route
show_output: show ip nat translations: empty; show run | section nat: acl not referenced in nat overload
expected_fault: NAT ACL misconfigured or not applied

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi clients can reach internal file server
topology_note: WLAN guest SSID mapped to VLAN 90
show_output: show vlan brief: guest SSID mapped to VLAN 10 instead of 90; no isolation ACL
expected_fault: Guest isolation failure / wrong VLAN mapping

symptom: Static route configured but traffic still fails to reach remote subnet
topology_note: Router R1 to R2 static route
show_output: show ip route: route present but next-hop unreachable; show cdp neighbors: R2 interface down
expected_fault: Next-hop interface down

symptom: Host cannot ping default gateway
show_output: show interfaces Gi0/3: line protocol down
expected_fault: Physical interface / cable issue

symptom: ACL blocks legitimate return traffic for a web request
show_output: show access-lists 110: missing established/return rule
expected_fault: ACL missing return traffic permit

symptom: Wireless clients get IP but cannot reach wired VLAN
show_output: show vlan brief: AP port not trunked, only access VLAN 1
expected_fault: Wireless AP not trunked to correct VLANs

symptom: OSPF neighbors not forming between two routers
topology_note: R1 and R2 on shared segment
show_output: show ip ospf neighbor: empty; show run: mismatched area IDs
expected_fault: OSPF area ID mismatch

symptom: Host has correct IP/mask/gateway but still no connectivity to gateway
show_output: show mac address-table: no entry learned for host MAC
expected_fault: Port security or MAC learning issue

symptom: Two switches on the same VLAN cannot see each other's MAC addresses
show_output: show spanning-tree: port in blocking state
expected_fault: STP blocking the only active link

symptom: Remote branch cannot reach HQ subnet over site-to-site link
topology_note: Router R1 HQ, R2 branch, static routes
show_output: show ip route on R2: default route present but no route back to HQ subnet
expected_fault: Missing return route on branch router

symptom: PC on VLAN15 gets APIPA address (169.254.x.x)
topology_note: VLAN15 access port, DHCP relay configured
show_output: show run: ip helper-address missing on VLAN15 SVI
expected_fault: Missing DHCP relay / ip helper-address

symptom: Voice VLAN phones cannot register with call manager
topology_note: Access port with voice VLAN 50 configured
show_output: show interfaces switchport: voice vlan not assigned
expected_fault: Voice VLAN not configured on access port

symptom: Host can ping by IP but not by hostname internally
show_output: show run | include dns; internal DNS server IP wrong in DHCP scope
expected_fault: Wrong internal DNS server IP in DHCP scope

symptom: NAT works for TCP but UDP-based apps fail (e.g. VoIP)
show_output: show ip nat translations: only TCP entries present; UDP timeout too short
expected_fault: NAT UDP timeout too aggressive

symptom: Port security shuts down access port after new laptop connects
topology_note: VLAN30 access port with port-security max 1
show_output: show interfaces status: port err-disabled
expected_fault: Port security violation, max MAC count exceeded

symptom: Wireless clients randomly disconnect every few minutes
show_output: show wireless: high channel utilization, overlapping SSIDs
expected_fault: Wireless channel interference/overlap

symptom: Inter-VLAN routing works for some VLANs but not a newly added one
show_output: show run: no sub-interface Gi0/0.100 configured
expected_fault: Missing sub-interface for new VLAN

symptom: Default route missing after router reload
topology_note: Router R1, static default route not saved
show_output: show run: no ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 entry; startup-config not saved
expected_fault: Configuration not saved before reload

symptom: ACL accidentally blocks DNS traffic to external server
show_output: show access-lists 120: no permit for udp port 53
expected_fault: ACL missing permit for DNS port 53

symptom: Trunk port negotiates as access port instead of trunk
show_output: show interfaces switchport: negotiated access instead of trunk
expected_fault: DTP negotiation failure / mismatched trunk mode

symptom: Guest wireless users cannot reach the internet at all
topology_note: Guest VLAN 90, NAT applied only to VLAN 10
show_output: show ip nat statistics: no translations for VLAN 90 source
expected_fault: Guest VLAN not included in NAT source ACL

symptom: Router OSPF routes flap intermittently
topology_note: R1-R2 link with unstable physical connection
show_output: show ip ospf events: frequent neighbor state changes; show interfaces: input errors present
expected_fault: Physical layer instability causing OSPF flapping

symptom: Server in VLAN5 unreachable from any other VLAN, but reachable within VLAN5
topology_note: VLAN5 server subnet, L3 switch SVI
show_output: show ip interface brief: VLAN5 SVI shows administratively down
expected_fault: VLAN5 SVI administratively down on L3 switch
